title: Ɔman Bi Kannifo a Wɔapaw no
intro: Wɔ bere a na nsɛnnennen ne abasamtu kɛse ma nkurɔfo bi mu no, wɔpaw ɔsoro. Saa onipa yi a mfiase no nnipa pii buu wɔn ani guu no so no, Allah na ɔpaw no sɛ onni ɔman bi anim nkɔko tia ɔtamfo a ne ho yɛ hu. Wɔn asɛm no yɛ adanse a ɛkyerɛ tumi a gyidi wɔ ne nyansa a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ahyɛde akyi, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ bere nyinaa na wohu nokware akanni wɔ mmeae a wɔhwɛ kwan.
clues: Allah yii me se menyɛ kannifoɔ mma me nkurɔfoɔ berɛ a wɔhwehwɛɛ sodifoɔ bi a ɔbɛko wɔ N’asɛm mu.
Mfiase no me nkurɔfo gyee me paw no ho kyim, na wɔtee nka sɛ afoforo fata kɛse esiane wɔn ahonyade anaa abusua a wofi mu nti.
M’akwankyerɛ a ɛfata ho sɛnkyerɛnne ne adaka kronkron bi a ɛsan bae, a adiyifo a wɔadi kan no nkaedum wom, a ɛde kommyɛ bae.
Midii m’asraafo no anim kɔɔ asubɔnten bi mu, faako a mesɔɔ wɔn osetie hwɛe denam bara a mebaraa wɔn sɛ wɔnnom nsu bɛboro kuruwa biako no so.
Ɛmfa ho sɛ na wɔn a wɔkɔɔ so gyinaa pintinn wɔ sɔhwɛ no akyi no mu kakraa bi no, yehyiaa ɔkofo a ɔyɛ den ne wɔn dɔm.
Wɔ m’ahyɛde ase no, aberante bi a ofi m’asraafo mu a na ɔnyɛ ɔkofo a wagye din no de akokoduru ne ɔtamfo ɔkannifo a ne ho yɛ hu no hyiae na odii so nkonim.

outcome.answer: Wodii atamfo no so nkonim, na Allah maa nkonimdie.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
